replacement: Le relazioni della lente e dell’ingrandimento qui usate richiedono il modello di lente sottile e raggi vicini all’asse; riflessione e rifrazione sono trattate nel modello dell’ottica geometrica.
reason: “Tutte queste leggi” includes the reflection law and Snell relation just introduced. Those do not require a thin lens or near-axis rays. The thin-lens conjugate/magnification equations do require the stated paraxial approximation.

counterexample.interpretation: Snell correctly diagnoses total internal reflection at ~64.16 degrees, outside the paraxial regime; the same lesson already includes this example.
